definitions.watchkeeping_period: Hours engaged in bridge or engine room navigational watch
definitions.rest_period: Continuous hours off-duty with full access to rest quarters
definitions.standard: IMO STCW 2010 Manila Amendments Table A-VIII/1 & MLC 2006 Standard A2.3

rules.text: Max 14 hours watch/duty in any 24-hour period.
Max 91 duty/watch hours in any 7 consecutive days (minimum 77 hours rest per 7d).
Max 260 transit hours in any 28 consecutive days.
Min 10 hours rest in any 24-hour period, divisible into no more than two periods, one at least 6h.
Vessel type, tonnage & propulsion qualification match (ULCV, LNG, DP2).
Valid STCW Certificate of Competency (CoC) and Type-Specific ECDIS.
Report port match or certified relief pilot transit within reachability window.
